Title: Add a no-write dashboard test mode
Problem / Request: Add a client-side test mode activated by ?mode=test to the Runtime Lite dashboard. It must load deterministic fixture data for the map, heat regions, recommendation, weather, events, flights, plan, pings, shift, trips, and status without calling Apps Script services, GPS, or Sheets. Show a permanent TEST MODE badge and disable all write-producing controls while keeping tabs and visual interactions testable. Normal mode must remain unchanged.
Acceptance Criteria: Opening the deployed dashboard with ?mode=test renders within one second using fixture data; makes no server, GPS, or sheet-write calls; visibly labels TEST MODE; disables shift, ping, trip, and refresh writes; permits navigation among all dashboard panels; and leaves normal mode behavior unchanged. Target only Index.Style, Index.Markup, and Index.Client where possible. No deployment or merge occurs automatically.
Branch / Build: Exact deterministic patch staged in Task Patches; no AI provider.
